hypothesis: With frozen H3 layer-49 K/V, the official FastWAM full 30-layer ActionDiT improves held-out action quality and fresh LIBERO success over an otherwise matched five-layer D0 action expert.
single_variable: Function-preserving expansion of the D0 action tower from 5 to 30 official FastWAM ActionDiT blocks; frozen H3 carrier, data, action contract, flow objective and evaluation protocol remain fixed.

paired_followup.evidence_boundary: C58 repeats H3 layer49 and is not a complete world-action joint-training reproduction; C58b isolates layer-wise H3 carrier routing.

references.title: H3-WAM C58 full-depth FastWAM backbone port

architecture.field: ActionDiT block execution and full depth
architecture.paper: FastWAM uses a full action expert coupled to the video world model.
architecture.local: Byte-pinned official ActionDiT code with hidden1024, FFN4096, head_dim128 and 30 blocks.

architecture.paper: Wan2.2 video expert, 24 heads; ActionDiT initialized by video-weight interpolation.
architecture.upstream_code: 24 heads and alpha-scaled linear interpolation from Wan video DiT.
architecture.local: Frozen H3 layer49 K/V requires 56 heads; D0 five blocks are anchored at 0/7/14/22/29 and other residual branches start as exact identities.
architecture.rationale: The H3 port consumes 7168D K/V without a new projection and preserves the already-trained D0 function exactly at step zero.

data.paper: FastWAM trains on LIBERO robot-video demonstrations.
data.upstream_code: All spatial/object/goal/libero10 datasets, stride1, 32 actions and 9 video frames.
data.local: All four LIBERO suites through the audited dense 200779-window manifest; C58 consumes a new 80000-window slice.
data.rationale: The H3 cache replaces online RGB encoding but retains dense windows, suites and horizon.

action.paper: LIBERO end-effector action chunks conditioned on proprioception.
action.upstream_code: 7D action, 8D state, horizon32 and min/max normalization.
action.rationale: No action representation or execution conversion changes in the architecture ablation.

objective.paper: Joint video and action flow matching through a world-action model.
objective.upstream_code: Video and action MoT losses; action scheduler train shift5.
objective.local: Same action shift5 velocity MSE and pad mask over frozen precomputed H3 K/V; video loss omitted.
objective.rationale: This experiment asks whether H3 world representations can drive the complete action expert; it is not a Wan video-model reproduction.

optimization.upstream_code: AdamW betas .9/.95, LR1e-4, WD1e-2, 5% warmup plus cosine, batch16 and 10 epochs for LIBERO.
optimization.local: AdamW and LR/WD/betas equivalent; global batch8, 1000 warmup, cosine horizon10000, 10000 steps and 80000 samples.
optimization.rationale: The diagnostic budget is bounded by the H3 project dataset and must be compared against a matched fresh-optimizer D0 arm, not official epoch numbers.

evaluation.upstream_code: Official LIBERO evaluator with action chunk replanning and task-specific max steps.
evaluation.local: Frozen v7 balanced-80 first, then new paired LIBERO trials with incumbent project replan8/no-ensemble contract.
evaluation.rationale: Project promotion requires a single stable replan8 protocol; offline metrics are explicitly not closed-loop evidence.

evidence: FastWAM commit 45d8e145 fixed; four execution source files are byte-pinned by SHA256 and loaded from a read-only cloud mirror.
Official full30 ActionDiT is disabled by default, only layer49 is consumed, and exact D0 step0 parity is covered by focused tests.
Trainer requires source/split/stats/cache identities and rejects any overlap with D0 consumed sample IDs.
C58 imports the audited D0 loader, action normalization, horizon32 padding mask and 7D deployment representation unchanged.
Shift5 flow velocity MSE is imported from D0; deterministic continuous-fp32 timestep/noise contracts are checkpointed.
AdamW betas .9/.95, LR1e-4, WD1e-2 and warmup-cosine are checkpointed; long launcher stages strictly restore optimizer and scheduler.

C58 adapter freezes v7 balanced-80 selected ID SHA256 26b0326d9694825dac3d6e1cccd0b55db03c7d0b78e56a441927e31d1eb99c42 and delegates all sampling/metrics to the existing evaluator; five drift-rejection tests pass.
Cloud 10-step BF16 probe observed finite nonzero gradients in all 30 blocks, range 0.0348871 to 2.00096.
8-GPU 10-step losses were finite (0.00842285 to 0.359375); peak allocated memory was 22.7113 GiB/GPU.
12,180,221,635-byte C58 step10 checkpoint strict-restored in a fresh invocation with fixed-probe max_abs=0.0; SHA256 4c47305c378567fcb6ce543e6924fdb7b316c39fee281c6aab80106de245c2b1.
D0-H32-s14000 SHA256 36c5615746fcd57f834db4cdbedd7a124174fca634786e1353871ded6b6e6de3 and step0 prediction max_abs=0.0.
No real C58 balanced-80 milestone has completed; no effect claim is permitted.
No fresh paired LIBERO closed-loop C58 result exists.

decision.rationale: Source, contract, all-30 gradient, finite smoke and strict restore gates pass. This authorizes a bounded diagnostic long run with 1000-step checkpoints, but not an effectiveness claim.
